case.court: United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit
case.limits: Section 230 protects the republication of someone else's content. A generated sentence has no other author to point at, and courts have so far been unwilling to assume the answer.
case.holding: Section 230 bars treating an interactive computer service as the publisher of information provided by another, and notice of the content does not remove that protection.
case.why_ai_cites_it: The foundation of every argument that an AI provider is a conduit for material originating elsewhere. Whether a model output counts as information provided by another information content provider is the unresolved question underneath a growing share of AI defamation claims.

section.name: AI Case Law: The Precedents Behind the Defenses
